requested_target_description: The primary composite of cardiovascular death or hospitalization for worsening heart failure, analyzed as time to first event during randomized trial follow-up. Compare assignment to empagliflozin 10 mg once daily versus placebo, each added to recommended therapy, among all randomized patients with heart failure and reduced ejection fraction. The intended comparative measure is the hazard ratio; trial follow-up is the window rather than a fixed-duration event risk.
scientific_review: The source explicitly supports the requested primary first-event composite, empagliflozin versus placebo assignment, ITT all-randomized population and full trial follow-up. Median 16 months is a summary, not a common fixed16month risk. The model extracted the correct HR/interval in the first attempt and retained this distinction. No valid card exists to certify its full exact claim. Later target_measurement=hazard ratio confuses endpoint ascertainment with effect measure; baseline_subgroup repeats the full randomized population instead of identifying a restriction; all exact cards omit clarity; every later card omits explicit effect_measure and all cards omit design_evidence.
